trust_decision.summary: No trust decision. A regex with polynomial backtracking (FIRST_NON_WHITESPACE_RE) is applied per line to untrusted docstring text while leading tabs are expanded; the fix replaces it with lstrip-based prefix computation.

landing_point.why: The summary says regex ReDoS on docstrings with leading tabs; the only such regex use is FIRST_NON_WHITESPACE_RE.match in lines_with_leading_tabs_expanded.

fix_sites.entry_point: black CLI (src/black/__init__.py:525), black.format_str (src/black/__init__.py:1196), black.format_file_contents (src/black/__init__.py:1061), blackd HTTP POST (src/blackd/__init__.py:126); all reach it via LineGenerator.visit_STRING -> fix_docstring (src/black/linegen.py:446 -> src/black/strings.py:75)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None of substance: every entry point funnels through the single function src/black/strings.py:47, so there is no out-of-scope site to argue about.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Leading tabs in docstring lines must still be expanded to 8-column spaces (only the leading whitespace run), whitespace-only lines and lines without leading whitespace kept as-is; minimum-indent computation in fix_docstring depends on this.

O6_input_shapes: line made only of tabs/whitespace with no non-whitespace character (the backtracking case)
leading whitespace mixing spaces and tabs before text

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A similar whitespace/prefix-capturing regex applied to string leaves (e.g. a planted nested-quantifier variant in prefix or indent handling)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The module already uses compiled regexes on raw string-leaf text; a maintainer could reasonably write another \s*-style pattern there. It would still be a WHERE-type, same-concept sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A docstring normalizer in the AST safety check that uses a backtracking regex instead of str.strip
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is a second docstring-whitespace routine in another module that runs on the same untrusted docstring. It is plausible but has to be planted; at the pinned commit it uses splitlines/strip.

O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_black.py (BlackTestCase), tests/data/cases docstring cases; no test for lines_with_leading_tabs_expanded at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Rewrite the regex as a non-backtracking pattern (e.g. ^[ \t]*) or replace it with lstrip() and expandtabs() on the prefix, which is exactly the published fix.

out_of_scope_notes: blib2to3 tokenizer regexes (src/blib2to3/pgen2/tokenize.py:158-170) also run on untrusted source; not part of this advisory and not examined for backtracking.
unverified: Latest release not provided, so present_in_latest is not applicable (O8 is empty).
